notes.note: Typed LaTeX lecture notes by the instructor, one PDF per lecture and per exam review (25), plus an all-in-one PDF. Transcribed page by page to raw/notes/ with the mathematics in LaTeX. There are no slides: the lectures are given at the blackboard.

figureAudit.note: false because no visual audit was run, not because something is unchecked: the transcribed notes (Lecture 1) contain no figures. Every equation in the Lecture 1 notes transcription was compared against the PDF's text layer in the parent; the prose was taken from the text layer, which is clean for pdfTeX output.

caveats: Covers Lecture 1 only (video 1 of 25: 23 lectures and two exam reviews). Topic pages reflect Lecture 1 only.
Completeness of R is deferred by the lecture to a later lecture and is not yet in this KB; the KB does not supply a definition.
Transcripts are a light copy-edit of OCW's professional captions; uncertain spots are marked [Ed: ...], and the verbatim captions are kept in raw/transcripts/original/.
The lecture notes transcription was read from page images by Sonnet; the parent checked every equation against the PDF text layer.
